mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 54 degrees.

The City of Verona is currently preparing for the November 4th Plan Commission meeting, which will review various development items including the Ardent Glen addition and site plans for Milky Way. Additionally, tax bills will be mailed out by December 15th, and residents can pay in installments.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, we have trivia nights at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee. Later in the week, you can enjoy pizza and trivia on Wednesday, Main Street Trick or Treat on October 29th, and live music at Bailey's Run on October 30th.

On Thursday, October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving behavior. Fortunately, there were no injuries reported during the incident.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Pumpkin Pecan. Please note that the store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
